8.29. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.path_area¶

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to both paths and areas.

Classes

AreaAfterAreaInPath([areaUserTypes, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area_1, area_2)’ if area_1 and area_2 of type AREA_TYPE with the user type in areaUserTypes are in path of type PATH_TYPE and area_2 is next to area_1.
AreaAfterPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if area of type AREA_TYPE is after path of type PATH_TYPE, which means the end node of path is in area.
AreaBeforePath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if area of type AREA_TYPE is before path of type PATH_TYPE, which means the start node of path is in area.
FirstAreaInPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if area of type AREA_TYPE is the first area in path of type PATH_TYPE.
LastAreaInPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if area of type AREA_TYPE is the last area in path of type PATH_TYPE.
NthAreaInPath(nthArea[, areaUserTypes, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if area of type AREA_TYPE with the user type in areaUserTypes is the nth area in path of type PATH_TYPE.
PathInArea([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if path of type PATH_TYPE is in area of type AREA_TYPE.
PathIntersectsArea([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, area)’ if path of type PATH_TYPE intersects with area of type AREA_TYPE.
PathIntersectsIndexedArea(ordinalUserType, …)
